tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Public facts for City of Trees House: occupancy, bedrooms, bathrooms, pets, stay bounds, and booking links. No live price.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether the house is open for checkIn, checkOut, and guests. petCount defaults to 0. This does not check minimum stay or return a price. Dates are not reserved.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Return a live PriceLabs quote and payment totals for checkIn, checkOut, guests, and optional petCount (defaults to 0). The quote expires in 30 minutes and does not reserve dates. Payment stays on the website.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Return a City of Trees House checkout link for the stay. The assistant must stop here. The guest reviews the current total, authorizes payment, and completes identity verification on the website. No payment or ID check through this tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_property" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
